title: Pin the intended validation branch in Git run-directory refusal controls
outcome: Give Git run-directory refusal rows an expected diagnostic so malformed one-line/control inputs cannot pass through the filesystem-rejection branch unnoticed. Preserve the no-artifact and no-registration assertions.
acceptance: The refusal table distinguishes the one-nonempty-absolute-path diagnostic from the unavailable-or-inaccessible filesystem diagnostic, while retaining the existing refusal side-effect witnesses.
Focused maintained controls pass on the final input, with review and full-gate evidence before landing.
